method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall in Asia as Oil Stokes Inflation Fears: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad Asia equity weakness driven by a spike in oil and rising inflation concerns — strong market/regime signal pointing to risk-off and potential earnings/valuation pressure across global equities.

Equities.title: Asian stocks dip as Brent holds above $100, yields near 2023 peak
Equities.reason: Reinforces a market regime of oil-driven inflation risk and higher global yields — a material negative for risk sentiment and broad equity multiples, especially cyclicals and rate-sensitive growth names.

Equities.title: S&P 500 ends down as oil tops $100 per barrel
Equities.reason: US large-cap benchmark retreats tied to oil surge — signals cross-market transmission of energy shock into US equity risk premium and headline earnings/inflation concerns.

Equities.title: Stock futures inch higher as traders brace for wholesale inflation report
Equities.reason: Market positioning ahead of inflation data introduces near-term volatility risk for equities; modestly negative as traders price potential upside to inflation and rates.

Equities.title: UBS CEO flags investor complacency as geopolitical and economic risks mount
Equities.summary: The UBS top boss cautioned that investors face an increasingly complicated environment given multiple headwinds.
Equities.reason: Top-bank commentary highlighting complacency amplifies downside risk sentiment and could pressure beta-sensitive flows into equities, reinforcing a cautious market regime.

Equities.title: World’s largest contract chipmaker TSMC sees August revenue surge over 53% to record high
Equities.summary: TSMC reported monthly sales revenue for August on Thursday.
Equities.reason: Strong TSMC revenue underscores ongoing AI/semiconductor demand — a powerful positive for tech leadership and the broader equity narrative around AI-driven earnings growth.

Equities.title: Justice Dept. Investigates Nvidia Deal With Groq
Equities.reason: Antitrust scrutiny of a major AI/semiconductor deal raises regulatory risk for sector consolidation and could weigh on investor enthusiasm for M&A-driven growth in tech.

Equities.title: Bank of Korea Warns on Derivatives Tied to Korean Chipmakers
Equities.reason: Central bank warning points to concentrated positioning and derivative risks in the Korean chip complex — a localized negative that can amplify volatility in regional equity markets and chip names.

Equities.title: Apple Introduces Foldable iPhone
Equities.reason: Major product launch from a megacap tech leader supports the technology leadership narrative and can sustain sector outperformance; positive for large-cap sentiment.

Equities.title: Bond sell-off, stock boom: Why rebalancing is a good strategy right now
Equities.summary: With stocks near all-time highs and bonds selling off, it's likely a good time for investors to consider rebalancing to their target risk, advisors said.
Equities.reason: Highlights stretched equity positioning amid a bond sell-off — modestly negative as it flags rebalancing risk and the potential for equity downside if fixed-income repricing continues.

Rates.title: Treasury yields jump as Bessent’s $6bn buyback plan disappoints investors
Rates.summary: 10-year borrowing costs hit highest level in nearly three years despite upsized repurchase programme
Rates.reason: High-signal market piece: yields have jumped to multiyear highs despite Treasury buyback — indicates bond selloff/higher-for-longer rates theme and insufficient policy support for bond prices.

Rates.title: US Treasury to buy up to $6 billion in Sept 10 buyback operation
Rates.reason: Operational Treasury buyback announcement — modestly supportive for bond prices (buybacks reduce supply), but limited scale relative to market moves so low-medium relevance.

Rates.title: China-US 10-Year Bond Yield Gap Widens to Record on Policy Split
Rates.reason: Widening China-US yield gap signals higher US yields and shifting global capital flows — reinforces global bond-selloff narrative and upward pressure on US borrowing costs.

Rates.title: Bond Market Rate Spiral Has Potent Accelerator Behind the Scenes
Rates.reason: Analysis pointing to accelerating upward pressure on yields — supports dominant narrative of a rate-driven bond selloff and higher-for-longer expectations.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Masu says expect to continue raising rates given current accommodative financial conditions
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) policy board member Kazuyuki Masu said on Thursday that the central bank expected to continue raising interest rates given current accommodative financial conditions.
Rates.reason: Explicit BoJ hawkish comments increase odds of further tightening — puts upward pressure on JGB yields and contributes to global rates tightening narrative.

Rates.title: Trump Payout Pledge Adds to Bond Market Jitters as Auction Looms
Rates.reason: Political fiscal pledges raising funding concerns ahead of auctions — increases risk premium on Treasuries and contributes to higher yields / market jitters.

Rates.title: Bessent’s political turn in GOP speech tests his bond-market credibility
Rates.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's Republican convention speech in Dallas is raising questions about how politics could affect market confidence in him.
Rates.reason: Political credibility concerns for Treasury leadership can weigh on market confidence around debt-management and contribute to higher yield volatility; medium-low relevance to immediate rates move.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens ahead of critical US inflation reports
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the fourth consecutive day and trading around 98.70 during Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: DXY weakening ahead of US inflation is a high‑impact USD story that drives flows across EUR/USD, JPY, CHF and EMFX — large market-wide FX transmission and immediate policy/cycle relevance.

FX.title: Euro: Firms against US Dollar as ECB hike in focus – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team expects the European Central Bank (ECB) to raise its deposit rate by 25bp to 2.50%, in line with consensus and market pricing, while President Lagarde is expected to retain full optionality on future moves.
FX.reason: ECB hiking expectations are a primary EUR/USD driver; a 25bp hike priced in supports euro strength vs USD and changes yield differentials that move FX flows.

FX.title: Euro holds recent gains despite high Oil prices with ECB decision in focus
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) edges up against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, but remains capped below Wednesday’s highs, at the 1.1650 area so far.
FX.reason: Market price action confirms EUR resilience vs USD ahead of ECB; supportive for EUR/USD but more of a confirming market move (moderate relevance).

FX.title: BoJ to raise rates to 1.25% this month — Reuters poll
FX.summary: A Reuters poll showed the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will hike interest rates to 1.25% at its September policy meeting and then to 1.75% in the second quarter (Q2) of 2027, earlier than previously expected, amid persistent concerns over broadening price pressures and
FX.reason: Earlier-than-expected BoJ tightening materially shifts JPY yield differentials and global FX positioning — a high-relevance structural driver for USD/JPY and broader risk flows.

FX.title: Japan must raise rates, central banker says
FX.summary: Hawkish BoJ comments follow pressure from Scott Bessent and volatility in currency and bond markets
FX.reason: Public hawkish BoJ commentary reinforces the tightening narrative and supports JPY strength via expectations and positioning — meaningful for USD/JPY and cross-asset flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risk supports against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Michael Pfister highlights that comments from the US Treasury Secretary about having “asymmetric information” on Bank of Japan (BoJ) moves are intended to deter speculative positioning for further Japanese Yen (JPY) weakness.
FX.reason: Intervention talk and signalling from US Treasury/other authorities raises the floor under JPY and alters risk-on positioning — a high-impact FX-specific flow driver.

FX.title: Yen May Climb Back Toward Upper 150s Per Dollar, Barclays Says
FX.reason: Macro desk view that JPY will strengthen vs USD is aligned with tightening BoJ expectations and can drive directional trading in USD/JPY and flows into JPY assets.

FX.title: Japanese Yen retreats from multi-month top vs USD as traders await US inflation data
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair edges higher during the Asian session on Thursday and trades just above mid-153.00s amid bears turn cautious ahead of US inflation figures.
FX.reason: Short-term USD/JPY bounce as traders reduce JPY exposure ahead of US CPI — a tactical USD strength move (lower relevance vs structural BoJ story).

FX.title: Swiss Franc gains as US Dollar weakens on Fed uncertainty
FX.summary: USD/CHF loses ground after registering gains in the previous day, trading around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: CHF appreciation tied explicitly to USD weakness and Fed uncertainty — confirms a broader USD softening theme and impacts safe-haven flows.

FX.title: Indian Rupee continues to feel heat from boiling oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its losing run against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Thursday. The USD/INR pair posts a fresh 10-day high at 95.31 as the ongoing rally in oil prices continues to batter the Indian currency.
FX.reason: Commodity-driven USD/INR weakness is a country-specific EMFX flow tied to oil; it reinforces pockets of USD strength even amid broader USD softness.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD trades firmly near $67.60 ahead of US PPI, CPI data
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades higher at around $67.60 during the Asian trading session on Thursday. The white metal reflects strength as the US Dollar is under pressure ahead of the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August, which will be p
Commodities.reason: Precious metals responding to USD weakness and incoming US inflation data is a normal bullish short-term driver for silver; medium relevance for commodities given macro sensitivity to USD/PPI/CPI.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to gains, eyes $4,450 as USD remains depressed ahead of US inflation data
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) turns higher following an intraday dip to sub-$4,400 levels on Thursday and moves further away from a one-week low touched the previous day. The commodity, however, remains below the $4,450 pivotal point as bulls seem hesitant ahead of US inflat
Commodities.reason: Gold benefiting from a softer USD and inflation-data uncertainty; meaningful for metals markets and inflation-driven positioning.

Commodities.title: Gold rises toward $4,420 as weaker dollar offsets Treasury yield pressure
Commodities.reason: Another report noting gold strength as USD weakness offsets yields — reinforces the short-term bullish precious-metals narrative ahead of US inflation prints.

Commodities.title: China Adds 650,000 Ounces of Gold in Biggest Monthly Buy Since 2023
Commodities.reason: Large official/central-bank gold buying is a material structural demand signal for gold markets and supports a stronger macro bullish gold narrative.

Commodities.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
Commodities.summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S
Commodities.reason: Higher US LNG exports raise global gas demand and tighten markets over time — constructive for natural gas prices and related energy flows.

Commodities.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
Commodities.summary: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry H
Commodities.reason: Regional supply/demand imbalances are depressing New England hub prices; locally bearish for that hub and a moderating factor for broader US gas price strength.

Commodities.title: Brent: Geopolitics keep rally supported – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent has broken above $100/bbl for the first time since July, driven by persistent geopolitical risk in the Persian Gulf and limited prospects for de-escalation between the US and Iran.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view tying Brent >$100 to ongoing Middle East geopolitical risk — strong, market-relevant narrative supporting a bullish crude/oil regime.

Commodities.title: Oil Extends Rally as Iran Says Ready for More Intense Conflict
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation rhetoric from Iran is an important supply-risk driver that supports sustained upside pressure on crude prices.

Commodities.title: Trading Day: $100 oil bites
Commodities.reason: Market commentary highlighting impact of $100+ oil on markets — reinforces oil-price regime and trader positioning concerns.

Commodities.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
Commodities.summary: What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallo
Commodities.reason: Elevated crack spreads point to stronger gasoline/diesel product prices and reflect tighter refined-product markets — supportive for RBOB and refinery margins.

Commodities.title: 'Saved the day': How China helped keep the lid on oil price surge as Iran war disrupted supplies
Commodities.summary: China's crude stockpiling and subsequent pullback on purchases since the war erupted in late February has helped the world avoid a deeper energy crisis.
Commodities.reason: China's earlier stockbuilding then pullback acted to moderate an even larger oil spike — a partial dampener on the pure geopolitics-driven rally.

Commodities.title: TotalEnergies announces oil discovery in Angola’s Block 17
Commodities.reason: New field discoveries are incremental future supply; modestly bearish on crude over the long run but low near-term market impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin climbs as oil tops $100, equities drop after Iran strikes
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical shock drove a risk-off move into BTC as a perceived safe-haven — a short-term positive liquidity/flow signal for crypto assets. Relevance moderate because it's event-driven and not a structural change.

Crypto.title: Coinbase CEO sees U.S. crypto regulation advancing regardless of Clarity Act vote
Crypto.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong says U.S. crypto regulation could move forward regardless of the outcome of the Clarity Act.
Crypto.reason: Significant regulatory clarity narrative from a major industry voice — generally supportive for institutional adoption and liquidity. High relevance as US regulatory outcomes materially affect market structure.

Crypto.title: Crypto wins regardless of Clarity Act vote, Coinbase's Armstrong says
Crypto.reason: Reinforces Coinbase CEO's message — repeated theme increases relevance for the regulatory/adoption narrative supporting crypto flows and institutional products.

Crypto.title: Hunter Biden’s LAPTOP blames bots after 98% crash as traders rack up six-figure losses
Crypto.reason: Large, rapid memecoin collapse and alleged bot-driven manipulation heighten retail risk perceptions and volatility — negative for market sentiment but idiosyncratic to memecoins.

Crypto.title: Tether pushes into private credit with $400 million fund with Fasanara
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin issuer moving into private credit signals diversification and deeper links between crypto liquidity pools and traditional credit markets — positive for institutionalization/liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum race quantum clock as U.S. backs $300 million hardware push
Crypto.reason: Quantum-computing risk frames a longer-term technical vulnerability for crypto primitives; modest negative because it's a structural tech threat but not immediate market-moving news.

Crypto.title: Kalshi election data goes live on DoubleZero ahead of U.S. midterms
Crypto.reason: Integration of real-world event data into on-chain markets nudges adoption of prediction-market use cases — small positive signal for product development in crypto.

Crypto.title: PayPal expands stablecoin rails with custom token issuance platform
Crypto.reason: Major payments player enabling custom stablecoin issuance is a strong institutional/adoption positive that can materially increase on-ramps and payments use cases — high relevance.

Crypto.title: U.S. Bank takes next step towards launching its stablecoin with cross-border payment test
Crypto.reason: Traditional bank progressing a stablecoin for cross-border payments is a material institutional adoption cue and supportive for crypto rails and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Wall Street's newest crypto fund comes with a staking feature to boost returns
Crypto.reason: Institutional product innovation (staking in a regulated fund wrapper) supports demand for PoS assets and broadens investor access — positive but niche.

Crypto.title: KYC data is an irresistible honeypot for hackers, and we must change how it is collected
Crypto.reason: Op-ed highlights operational/security risk around KYC — negative for custodial confidence and platform risk, but opinion pieces have limited immediate market impact.

Crypto.title: Germany moves to tax bitcoin like stocks as new draft bill targets tax-free gains
Crypto.reason: A major European market proposing to remove tax-free gains materially affects retail economics and could reduce local demand — significant regulatory headwind for crypto adoption.

Crypto.title: Crypto lobbying orgs ask court to suspend Illinois tax as legal case continues
Crypto.reason: Ongoing legal fights over state-level crypto taxes highlight regulatory fragmentation and uncertainty — modest negative while case outcome is unresolved.

Crypto.title: India’s financial intelligence unit flags 15 crypto platforms for AML lapses
Crypto.reason: Regulatory enforcement in a large EM market on AML lapses is a meaningful negative for platform operations and could reduce regional liquidity and trust.

Crypto.title: Dogecoin sinks 5% to lead majors losses, with bitcoin holding $78,000 level
Crypto.reason: Intraday price move in a major altcoin — negative for short-term risk sentiment in altcoins but limited structural importance (technical/price headline).
